s.en: Tool for displaying and modifying the authentication failure record files

o.en: The file where the configuration is located. The default is /etc/security/faillock.conf.

The directory where the user files with the failure records are kept. The priority to set this option is to use the value provided from the command line. If this isn't provided, then the value from the configuration file is used. Finally, if neither of them has been provided, then /var/run/faillock is used.
The user whose failure records should be displayed or cleared.
Instead of displaying the user's failure records, clear them.
